infra-oncall: agree with rollback. opening ops incident INC-1024 and pausing canary. tagging SRE.

jamie: create rollback run and pin to previous commit. @deploy-bot can you start a revert?

alexa: :thumbsup: good catch. we'll vet the drain hook and add more graceful cordon/drain checks before any resize.

jamie: opening short postmortem and rollback blameless notes. assigning owners: infra (drain script) and SRE (investigate runtime timeouts).

marco: thanks — leaving canary paused until we have a fix and a controlled smaller resize test.
